prologue.warmth.line:
Three hearths once kept the roads warm.
We lived beyond their walls.
prologue.warmth.title: Remembered warmth
prologue.warmth.speaker: Hamlet witness
prologue.year.line:
The cities burned toward their towers.
The bells fell silent. No spring followed.
prologue.year.title: The Burning
prologue.year.speaker: Hamlet witness
prologue.carry.line: You took up what was left by the door, and went out into the grey.
prologue.carry.title: What the fire left
prologue.carry.speaker: {class}
prologue.carry.line.reaver: The Fell Courtyard gate fell. My watch never ended.
prologue.carry.line.starseer: I took his charts. I still owe him an answer.
prologue.carry.line.rogue: The Court Surgeon kept my sister. I kept his trail.
prologue.carry.line.herald: The fire stopped on me. The Chapel still owes an answer.
prologue.night.line:
They never marked him.
I washed the ash from his hands.
He is still breathing.
prologue.night.title: Last night
prologue.night.speaker: Hamlet witness
prologue.step.line: I will find a road to the hearths.
prologue.step.title: The first step
prologue.step.speaker: {name}
